description: Opt-in preset for the groundwork platform repos that pin jasondockery/groundwork-core as the core submodule. Extend it alongside the shared default preset; it does not replace it.

git-submodules is off by default in Renovate. Its git-refs datasource has no release timestamps, so under the shared strict 5-day floor every bump would stay pending forever. Reading groundwork-core tags through github-tags supplies timestamps and the tag's commit, so the inherited floor is honored.
Consumers set branch = <current tag> in .gitmodules so Renovate tracks semver tags instead of HEAD digests.

Adoption requirement: at adoption the core gitlink must equal the commit of the tag named in `branch =`. Renovate's lookup always adds a digest update to the tag commit, and this preset disables core digest-only updates (version updates still carry newDigest), so a gitlink that does not match its tag is never silently moved by a digest PR.

Consumer group rules must exclude git-submodules, otherwise a consumer rule such as groupName "non-major dependencies" (applied after preset rules) will absorb core bumps. Add "excludeDepNames": ["core"] to that rule, or use "matchManagers" with every manager except git-submodules.

packageRules.description: groundwork-core pin bumps via github-tags; own group; human merge only. Age floor and internalChecksFilter are inherited from the default preset.

Disable digest-only updates for core. Renovate's lookup always adds a digest update to the tag commit; a gitlink that is not exactly the tagged commit must not open a PR that moves it. Version updates still carry newDigest.
Keep every git-submodules dependency other than core disabled. Its git-refs datasource has no release timestamps, so under the strict age floor it would sit pending forever.
